facts.fact: Digital minister Eberande Kolongele inaugurated the Centre des hautes etudes technologiques Triomphal on 23 May 2024, where state agents are to follow free, state-funded 4-to-6-month courses in digital service optimisation, digital leadership, data science and cybersecurity, delivered with the Canadian firm STEMWORLD Services.
facts.system: Centre des hautes etudes technologiques Triomphal (H.E.T Triomphal)
